findings.title: Allow empty successful format logs in producer evidence admission
findings.issue: regular() requires s.size>0 and line78 applies it to every actual suite log, including format.log. The pinned suite producer can validly emit a zero-byte format.log after successful cargo fmt --all --check, and reviewed builder-v2 explicitly accepts its empty SHA and empty summaries. This driver therefore rejects a legitimate accepted current-suite proof before any physical case.
